title: Table 53. IWDG min/max timeout period at 40 kHz (LSI)
text_helper: Table 53. IWDG min/max timeout period at 40 kHz (LSI) — section 6.3.18 Timer characteristics. Prescaler divider, stib ]0:2[RP, Min timeout RL[11:0]= 0x000, Max timeout RL[11:0]= 0xFFF, Unit.

notes: 1. Data based on characterization results, not tested in production.
2. Min time is for the minimum time to drive the output and the max time is for the maximum time to validate the data.
3. Min time is for the minimum time to invalidate the output and the max time is for the maximum time to put the data in Hi-Z DS10697 Rev 4 67/84
